# Mohammad Khoddami

> Full-stack AI engineer building production-grade generative AI systems: RAG
> pipelines, multi-node LangGraph agent architectures, and the governance layers
> that keep them honest. Works forward-deployed, directly with clients, from spec
> to production.

Based in Iran. Languages: English (bilingual proficiency), Persian (native).

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://mohammad007kh.github.io/): Single-page portfolio covering
  positioning, selected work, technical stack, teaching, and credentials.

## Selected work

- [Atomic Spec](https://chappygo-os.github.io/Atomic-Spec/): Open-source
  governance layer for AI coding agents. Nine Prime Directives and gated
  checkpoints that stop an agent from confidently shipping the wrong code.
  v0.5.0 derives a per-layer test strategy from one up-front question, routes it
  through 12 testing subagents, and requires human approval before scheduling
  test tasks. Validated end-to-end on 5 agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub
  Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf); 12 more experimental, 17 total.
- [Internal Knowledge AI Agent](https://github.com/mohammad007kh/Internal-Knowledge-AI-Agent/):
  Enterprise knowledge retrieval. A 10-node LangGraph pipeline with intent
  clarification, self-critique, and full observability, on FastAPI, PostgreSQL +
  pgvector, and Celery. In development.
- AI content and document generation platforms: Two multi-tenant SaaS products in
  production. One runs multi-mode AI content generation with credit metering and
  a multi-language UI. The other does RAG-grounded document drafting with
  per-clause source citation, structure-aware chunking, and confidence scoring.
  Client work; product names withheld.
- [LM Studio Persian localization](https://github.com/lmstudio-ai/localization):
  First Farsi translation for the local-LLM application. Open-source
  contribution.

## Stack

AI/LLM: LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, pgvector,
FAISS, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Langfuse, OpenAI, Hugging Face.
Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Node.js, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis,
Celery, SQLAlchemy, Alembic.
Frontend: Next.js 15, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Streamlit.
Infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Git, CI/CD, MinIO.
